feeds.title: Travel Freak
feeds.description: Welcome to TravelFreak by Jeremy Scott Foster. I don't believe in living life on someone else's terms. I believe in making the most out of every opportunity and living life on your own terms. On this blog, I showcase unique stories of transformation, adventure and motivation. Hopefully, it will get you out of the house and trying something you probably never thought you would.

feeds.title: Escaping Abroad Blog
feeds.description: If you're thinking about taking the plunge and travelling solo, James's blog - Escaping Abroad will probably push you over the edge. The Blog features photos, videos and stories from adventures around the globe. He started this blog to share his passion for traveling and to inspire readers to go out and do more exploring of their own.

feeds.title: Nomadic Matt Blog
feeds.description: The travel blog of Nomadic Matt features tips and advice on how you can travel better, cheaper, and smarter so you can explore the world on a budget. Hi, I'm Nomadic Matt, a New York Times best-selling author of How to Travel the World on $50 a Day and Ten Years a Nomad as well as the founder of this website.

feeds.title: Dan Flying Solo Blog
feeds.description: Travel Photographer and Travel Blogger focused on Asia, Europe & Australia. Follow us to keep up with Travel guides, tips and stories to plan your next adventure.

feeds.title: FootLoose Dev
feeds.description: Tips and advice on how to solo-travel around the world. Follow Footloosedev, an Indian travel blogger, on his adventures.

feeds.title: Travelsewhere
feeds.description: David Johnston shares articles and photos from lesser-seen destinations and experiences from Europe and the World. David is an Australian travel blogger who focuses on the history and outdoor travel.

feeds.title: A boy who travels
feeds.description: Hello! I am Shubham Mansingka. I spend most of my time on the road, and make full use of my life after a battle with asthma. I hope my experiences excite you to see more of this world.

feeds.title: Travel Dave
feeds.description: Follow us to keep up with UK's leading solo adventure travel blogger Dave Brett on his travels around the world. A globe-trotting adventure travel blog featuring travel tips and advice, exotic stories, travel videos and travel photography that will inspire your next trip abroad, and help you plan it too.

feeds.title: Journey Era Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Journey Era by Jackson Groves. I've been backpacking and exploring epic locations around the world for over 2 years. I've never spent more than $12 a night on accommodation and am always looking for real adventures like treks, waterfalls and cliff jumping!

feeds.title: Indie Traveller
feeds.description: Marek has been travelling long-term since 2012, having embarked upon a two-month trip to Thailand which spiralled into a two-year trip around the world! On this blog I hope to encourage others to travel more and to travel independently, by sharing real stories and honest advice. I think too much travel information gets glorified by travel guides trying too hard to sell a destination - instead I want to try and give you an honest perspective.

feeds.title: Travelmax
feeds.description: Hey! I am Umang Trivedi and I write my travel stories around adventure, offbeat travel & amazing experiences here.

feeds.title: Skye Travels
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Skye from SkyeTravels. I want to see every country in the world. Yeah, that's kinda corny and ambitious, but I love seeing new cultures and learning as much as I can. I love food and I can't ever seem to try enough new dishes. I've also been a chef and I enjoy learning how to make the meals I try. The plan is to have home bases around the world from which I can travel from. While my blog focuses on solo travel, I'd love to have a partner along for the adventure.

feeds.title: Rangan Datta
feeds.description: Blog by independent researcher, travelogue writer & photographer Rangan Datta.

feeds.title: Lost on The Route
feeds.description: Lost on the Route is a travel blog that provides complete travel guides and travel resources about Italy and the world. Discover the World of Travelling: Travel News, Tips, Guides, Curiosities, Suggestions, Inspiration, and much much more.

feeds.title: Land Lopers Blog
feeds.description: LandLopers is an experiential luxury travel blog with reviews and tips for everyone from the novice to the pro traveler. Matt has a true passion for travel. As someone who has a bad case of the travel bug, he travels the world in order to share tips on where to go, what to see and how to experience the best the world has to offer.

feeds.title: Mark My Adventure Blog
feeds.description: Mark My Adventure is a place to know about the destinations. Tips & tricks to cover the places in a budget-friendly way. This page is for all the backpackers.

feeds.title: DIARY OF A JADED 80'S BABY
feeds.description: World traveler. Financial freedom fighter. Breaker of molds. Destroyer of misconceptions. My name is Derek, and I'm a jaded 80's baby.

feeds.title: Explore with Jeph
feeds.description: Jeph is a social guy with a big smile and with 3 passions: People, Travel and Social Media. He loves traveling as it gives him the opportunity to meet other people from different parts of the world and experience different cultures and explore beautiful places.

feeds.title: Lonely Travelog
feeds.description: Daeng Rizam resides in a small little dot city-state called Singapore. He is a travel bugger who enjoys photography. Beneath his smile lies a conglomerate of thoughts, a curiosity to discover the world. He appreciates the simple things in life. The life he has always wanted is to see the world and taste the fullness of life. He believes traveling broadens his mind in many ways. He learns the differences and embraces the similarities of one's culture.

feeds.title: #Robventures Blog
feeds.description: An American boy living in Norway while traveling the world. A true story of redemption after jail, drugs, and prison. Learn how writing and traveling saved my life.

feeds.title: theroytravels
feeds.description: An amateur globetrotter with lots of passion to share my experiences.

feeds.title: Voyage Nomad
feeds.description: Indian Travel Blogger sharing best travel stories,trip itineraries, advice, tips, and inspiration for world travelers seeking their next vacation destination.

feeds.title: The Young Travelier
feeds.description: A hotel review blog from the perspective of a self proclaimed luxury hotel junkie. 300 hotels and 40 countries and counting!

feeds.title: Aldo Bodogo » Travel
feeds.description: Aldo is a life-long traveler with extensive experience planning itineraries, figuring out logistics, navigating airports and train stations, staying in hotels, dining in restaurants, and drinking in bars. He appreciates architecture, art, and photography and enjoys sharing photos from his journeys in hopes to inspire others to travel.

feeds.title: A Backpacker's World
feeds.description: A backpacker's world is a travel blog by Josh Band, a 19 year old travel blogger from Northern Ireland who gives tips and advices on solo travel and budget travel that allows people to see the world for cheap.

feeds.title: Moving Jack
feeds.description: Moving Jack moves to a new country every two years. This provides a one-of-a-kind opportunity to engage with places and cultures in ways that go beyond the average vacation. Through photography and stories focused on positivity, diversity, and authenticity, Moving Jack aims to show people the beauty of different cultures.

feeds.title: Simon's JamJar
feeds.description: Welcome to Simon's JamJar! an award-winning UK travel storytelling blog, from UK male travel blogger, Simon Heyes.

feeds.title: Minority Nomad Blog
feeds.description: I'm Erick! Photographer, Philanthropist, and World Traveler. On a quest to become the first African American to visit every country in the world. 92 Countries DONE!!! Follow my journey and all of the amazing places I've seen and people I've met here.
